existing_rows_audit.detail: Abu Dhabi is out of scope for this pass, so the row is out-of-geography regardless. On the merits: ADIA's own careers portal has no role titled 'ML Researcher'. The closest live reqs are 'Quantitative Researchers & Developers' (open since 2021-09-29, https://jobs.adia.ae/_/jobs/view/4CFA7E24F7.md) and 'Quantitative Researcher & Developer - Data Science' (posted 2024-12-04, https://jobs.adia.ae/_/jobs/view/F18DA76604.md), plus 'ADIA Lab - Senior Computational Scientist - Trustworthy AI' (https://jobs.adia.ae/_/jobs/view/1B132ECDDD.md). All are Abu Dhabi, workplace 'on_site'. So the office and the research-track hiring are real, but the exact title is not, and the comp figure ($250-400k tax-free) is nowhere stated on any ADIA posting - treat it as unsourced. The 'Source / Verify' URL in the existing row (https://www.adia.ae/en/careers) is a dead 404; the live careers entry point is https://jobs.adia.ae/.

notes:
RESULT: ADIA has zero openings in the target geography. Full enumeration of the firm's own applicant tracking system on 2026-08-04 returned exactly 9 open positions, every one of them located in 'Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates' with workplace 'on_site'. Machine-readable listing: https://jobs.adia.ae/_/jobs.md (Last updated: 2026-08-04). The 9 are: ADIA Lab - Senior Computational Scientist - Trustworthy AI; UAE National Mustaqbali Program (Grade 9/Year 10 students); ADIA Study Abroad Scholarship; ADIA UAE National Internship and Employment Opportunities; ADIA - High School Math Club; ADIA Local Scholarship Program; 2026 ADIA Residency Program; Quantitative Researcher & Developer - Data Science; Quantitative Researchers & Developers. Nothing in the EU, UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Shanghai or Tokyo. 'Team Q' (the Quantitative Research & Development group under the 'Strategy and Planning' department) is an Abu Dhabi seat only.

OFFICES: adia.ae's contact page lists a single address, '211 Corniche, PO Box 3600, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates' - no branch offices are published by the firm. Secondary sources report an ADIA Hong Kong representative office opened October 2016 (Dong-Sinh Ngo appointed Chief Representative, Asia Pacific; e.g. gulfnews.com/business/abu-dhabi-investment-authority-opens-hong-kong-office-1.1919994) and a London presence, but I could not confirm either on an ADIA-owned page, and no ADIA req is posted against either city. Both are deal-sourcing/representative offices for private markets, not quant research seats, so I have left offices_in_scope_confirmed empty rather than assert them. Separately, ADIA Lab (an affiliated data/computational-science research institute, adialab.ae) announced a European headquarters in Granada, Spain - reported by the Spanish government (digital.gob.es) and ADIA Lab itself - but its only live vacancy is the Abu Dhabi Senior Computational Scientist role, so Granada yields nothing actionable either.

BLOCKERS/CAVEATS: https://www.adia.ae/en/careers returns 404. jobs.adia.ae renders client-side only; I retrieved the full listing via the site's own llms.txt-advertised markdown endpoints (https://jobs.adia.ae/_/llms.txt -> /_/jobs.md -> /_/jobs/view/<id>.md), which are primary and firm-hosted. No compensation figure appears on any ADIA posting; the $250-400k tax-free number carried in the existing spreadsheet row has no primary source I could locate and should not be relied on. Note also that ADIA's quant reqs are evergreen (one has been open since 2021), so 'live' there means 'accepting applications', not 'newly posted'.
